T-001.Title: Derive cursor state from the current range's closer

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red first, in its own tool round trip (signature-kind test, signature-key grace-cursor): author guard (i) `AC-END-STATE-READS-COMPLETE` and the two shape-(B) risk tests in `src/grace-cursor.test.ts`, on an isolated bundle root (never the production record). Guard (i): seed a bundle whose plan declares a `MustPassCommand`; `advanceCursor` open (bounded, e.g. `from: 1, to: 20`), one `progress`, one `terminal`, `foldEpoch` applies; `lintGraceProject(root, { assertionMode: "final", changeId, runCommands: true })` writes a loose `command-run`; one `terminal`; `foldEpoch` applies; assert `showCursor(root, id).state` is `"complete"` **and** the written `run.xml` carries `<State>complete</State>`. On the base tree the second `foldEpoch` applies but `showCursor(...).state` is `"in-progress"` (ledger tail `terminal, opened`); paste the tail. Risk test A (bounded reopen): fold an epoch, then `advanceCursor` open with `from: 1, to: 99` — assert the position is `"in-progress"`. Risk test B (stray terminal): open, progress, terminal, progress — assert the position is `"complete"` and `foldEpoch` applies. Record exactly **one** `cursor attempt --outcome fail` for the pair; do not land production in this round trip.

Production (own tool round trip after the red): in `src/grace-cursor.ts` add the module-private helpers `currentRangeEvents(bundlePath)` (the loose `run/` events when any exist, else the last folded ledger epoch's `Event` children) and `currentRangeCloserState(bundlePath)` (the last range-closing event's mapped state, or `undefined`), and a private `derivePositionState(bundlePath)` that keeps escalation and circuit precedence from the **whole** stream (`deriveStateFromEvents(stream)` sticky result: `paused-pending-approval` / `paused-pending-supersede` win) and otherwise returns the current range's closer state when it has one, else the last-event-wins state. Replace the `deriveStateFromEvents(stream)` calls in `positionProjectionFromBundle` (`:526`) and both `derivePosition` sites (`:1422`, `:1537`) with `derivePositionState(bundlePath)`. Do **not** change `deriveStateFromEvents`'s signature or its escalation/circuit logic, do **not** export the new helpers, do **not** touch `nextEventId`, `writeEventFile`, `writeCoveringOpened` or `withEventWriteLock`. Record exactly **one** `cursor attempt --outcome pass` for the pair. Failure conditions: risk test A reds (a merged-stream form of the rule); risk test B reds (the closer is not scoped to the current range); a new export or `MODULE_MAP` entry; a new `unlinkSync`/`rmSync` site under `src/`; the sticky states no longer win over a closer.

**Own-stream field test.** After this task's production edit lands, the executing agent's own end-state sequence is the field test: `ngrace cursor fold`, then `ngrace lint --path . --assertions final --run-commands` (writes the loose `command-run`), then `ngrace cursor advance --change C-CURSOR-STATE-HONESTY-1-53C5EC0B --task T-001 --kind terminal`, then `ngrace cursor fold`, then `ngrace cursor show --change C-CURSOR-STATE-HONESTY-1-53C5EC0B` must print `State: complete`.
